# Pinned to tracebloc-engine's runtime versions so CI validates templates
# against what the fleet actually runs (backend#2658, backend#2752).
#
# Unpinned, CI resolved whatever PyPI served that day while the engine pins
# the versions below — so a template could pass here and be broken on the
# edge, silently, and only for customers. That is not hypothetical: the same
# gap on the pytorch env let sapiens' LoRA target_modules (written for
# transformers 5.12's attention naming, against the engine's 5.8.0) go green
# in CI and fail to construct at all on the edge (backend#2641).
#
# All of these come from tracebloc-engine's use_cases/requirements.txt. Bump
# them together with the engine's pins, never ahead of them. That ordering is
# the entire point -- and it is a comment, not a check, until backend#2753
# lands the scheduled drift detection.
#
# pytest is deliberately NOT pinned: it does not appear in the engine's
# requirements, so there is nothing to sync it to, and inventing a pin would
# assert an agreement that does not exist. Same call as the pytorch env.
pytest
scikit-learn==1.8.0
xgboost==3.2.0
lightgbm==4.6.0
catboost==1.2.10
interpret==0.6.9
